name: Tsuruta (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Tsuruta town emblem in white: a broken ring enclosing two stylised strokes like a letter U.
history: Municipal flag of Tsuruta, a town in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 27 June 1997; the emblem dates from 8 August 1956.

features.role: Tsuruta town emblem — a broken ring enclosing two stylised strokes like a letter U
